say:1:1230211001:0.text: This is the best-selling fish in Rustport!
say:1:1230211001:0.source_cn: 这可是锈锚港里卖的最好的鱼种！
say:1:1230211001:0.male: This is the best-selling fish in Rustport!
say:1:1230211001:0.female: This is the best-selling fish in Rustport!

say:2:1230211002:0.text: Grass carp have flavorful flesh as they only eat moss.
say:2:1230211002:0.source_cn: 苔鲤因为只吃苔藓，所以它的肉质也十分鲜美。
say:2:1230211002:0.male: Grass carp have flavorful flesh as they only eat moss.
say:2:1230211002:0.female: Grass carp have flavorful flesh as they only eat moss.

say:3:1230211003:0.text: After eating their fill, they like to swim upstream in fast-moving waters, which makes their flesh firm.
say:3:1230211003:0.source_cn: 苔鲤吃饱后，喜欢在水流湍急的地方逆流而上，所以肉质紧实。
say:3:1230211003:0.male: After eating their fill, they like to swim upstream in fast-moving waters, which makes their flesh firm.
say:3:1230211003:0.female: After eating their fill, they like to swim upstream in fast-moving waters, which makes their flesh firm.

say:4:1230211004:0.text: I hope I'll get a good haul here.
say:4:1230211004:0.source_cn: 希望我在这里能有个好的收获。
say:4:1230211004:0.male: I hope I'll get a good haul here.
say:4:1230211004:0.female: I hope I'll get a good haul here.
